description: 🚀 Ready to uncover the mysteries of space? We’re enthusiastic beginners passionate about space,science, research, creative storytelling, and visual communication. We aim to build an exciting project using real NASA data to make space exploration more accessible and interactive.We welcome students,beginners,writers,designers and researchers. No prior experience is required-just creativity, curiosity, teamwork and a willingness to learn. Join us...Let's create something big together
summary:
SpaceTales is a storytelling-based educational project that brings the forgotten history of NASA's space exploration to life. It explores the abandoned equipment, rovers, landers, and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon and Mars after completing their missions.
Through engaging visuals, adventure, mystery, and scientific storytelling, SpaceTales introduces audiences aged 8 and above to these remarkable machines, explaining why they were sent into space, what they accomplished, and the discoveries they helped humanity make.
Our goal is to transform complex space exploration history into an interesting and accessible experience that inspires curiosity about science, technology, engineering, and future space exploration.
SpaceTales reminds us that even when a mission ends, its contribution to science is never forgotten.
details:
SpaceTales is a story-driven educational magazine designed to bring NASA’s discarded hardware on the Moon and Mars back to life for school-age space enthusiasts. Traditionally, space enthusiasts hear only about active, ongoing missions while retired spacecraft sit forgotten. Our flip book uniquely transforms dense historical mission data into an engaging visual narrative—connecting the engineering of silent rovers, landers, and descent stages directly to the groundbreaking science they achieved.
Key Considerations:
• The project is designed for school-age space enthusiasts and a younger to spark their imagination and introduce them to space exploration.
• The chosen format is a flip book, which offers a highly accessible, tactile, and visual medium
•It focuses on specific historical missions and discarded equipments left behind on both the Moon and Mars
•It highlights a narrative, story-driven perspective—treating these silent, off-world artifacts
Creative Elements :
• Built to be researcher-friendly with exportable visuals,
• Includes a compelling story that connects molecular insights to real astronaut risks,
• Uses an interface that simplifies complex bioinformatics into visual exploration.
